latest_release.body:
### ✨ What's new

- **See what every agent is doing.** The refreshed cockpit shows live task previews, each task's open tabs, and a quick way to jump to the page you need. Quiet tasks now show as idle.

- **Replay tasks at full size.** Open a recording full screen with its steps alongside it. Press **F** to open the replay and **Esc** to return.

- **Find and reuse your skills.** Saved skills now appear as cards with site icons, clearer names, and token savings.

**Maintenance build 0.52.1.1** corrects installer versioning for the 0.52 update. Downloads below use this build.

[Checksums for 0.52.1.1](https://github.com/browseros-ai/BrowserOS/releases/download/browserclaw/v0.52.0/SHA256SUMS-0.52.1.1.txt)

detail.readme:
Put Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode to work on your real tasks. BrowserOS neo connects to the agents you already use, lets them use your logged-in sessions and helps you get things done!

## Quick start 1. **Install.** Use a button above, or Homebrew: ```sh brew tap browseros-ai/tap brew install --cask browseros-neo ``` 2. (optional) **Import from Chrome.** One click brings your logins, bookmarks and extensions. 3. **Automatically connects to your agents.** neo finds Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code and more on your machine and connects to them automatically. 4. **Start getting things done!** Give a task to your agent and you just watch. > Book me the cheapest flight to London. ## What you get - **Signed in as you.** Agents work in your real accounts, not a blank sandbox. - **Their own tabs.** Every agent gets its own tab group. Run many at once. Your tabs stay yours. - **You can watch.** Follow each step live, or replay any session later. - **Hand-off.** Stuck at a login? neo notifies you, you help, the agent carries on. - **Fewer tokens.** neo reads a page as short text, not as screenshots. - **Local.** Sessions, screenshots and history stay on your machine.

## What agents do with it - **Sales.** Select leads in Salesforce and copy them into your outreach sheet. - **Coding.** Deploy a function on AWS and check that the update went live. - **Research.** Compare Reddit and X posts and save the sources behind your answer. - **Finance.** Check bills in Brex against purchase orders and flag extra charges. ## Benchmarks About **63% faster** and **40% fewer tokens** than the browsers built into Claude and ChatGPT, and it finishes about **96%** of tasks. These figures are approximate, and the full benchmark write-up is not published yet. | Tool | Time per task | Tokens per task | Tasks finished | | :-- | --: | --: | --: | | **BrowserOS neo** | **~102 s** | **~21.6k** | **~96%** | | Claude’s built-in browser | ~264 s | ~35.4k | n/a | | ChatGPT’s built-in browser | ~276 s | ~35.8k | n/a | | `chrome-devtools-mcp` | ~192 s | ~29.4k | ~84% | | `playwright-mcp` | ~214 s | ~31.2k | ~76% | ## Why not something else? | Instead of | The catch | With neo | | :-- | :-- | :-- | | **Headless drivers**
Playwright MCP, agent-browser | A fresh Chrome with no logins. Fine for CI, not for your inbox. | Your logins, imported from Chrome in one click. | | **Cloud browsers**
Browserbase, browser-use | Datacenter IPs get blocked, and signing in is a chore. | Runs on your machine, at `127.0.0.1`. | | **AI browsers**
Atlas, Comet, Dia | Each works only with its own AI. | Works with the agent you already pay for. | ## FAQ
Which agents work with neo? Any agent that speaks MCP. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Antigravity, VS Code and Zed connect in one click. Claude Desktop takes a one-file extension, and anything else connects with the endpoint URL. [Setup guide](https://docs.browseros.com/neo/mcp).
Can I keep using my browser while agents work? Yes. Agents work in their own tab group. Your tabs stay yours.
Does anything leave my machine? Sessions, screenshots and history stay on your disk. neo sends anonymous usage events (never URLs, page content or prompts); one toggle in Settings turns them off. [Full policy](https://docs.browseros.com/neo/privacy).
Do my Chrome extensions and bookmarks work? Yes. neo is a Chromium fork, so extensions work, and bookmarks, passwords and settings import in one click.
## Community and contributing [Website](https://www.browseros.com) · [Docs](https://docs.browseros.com) · [Discord](https://discord.gg/YKwjt5vuKr) · [Slack](https://dub.sh/browserOS-slack) · [X](https://x.com/browserOS_ai) · [Report a bug](https://github.com/browseros-ai/BrowserOS/issues) · [Enterprise](mailto:founders@browseros.com?subject=Enterprise%3A%20BrowserOS%20neo) We would love your help. The [Contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) routes you: the neo app (TypeScript, React, Rust) sets up in about 15 minutes; the browser (C++, Python) needs about 100 GB of disk. > [!TIP] > **Support open-source agent browsing.** [Star the repo](https://github.com/browseros-ai/BrowserOS) and watch releases to hear when agents can do something new. > > [![Star BrowserOS on GitHub](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/browseros-ai/BrowserOS?style=social)](https://github.com/browseros-ai/BrowserOS) Credits: [Chromium](https://www.chromium.org/) and [ungoogled-chromium](https://github.com/ungoogled-software/ungoogled-chromium) · [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE) · © 2026 Felafax, Inc. ## Stargazers Thank you to all our supporters.
